description: Pin bun+Node to a single source of truth consumed by CI, the Dockerfile, and a fail-closed container preflight with sidecar auto-rebuild; add a check:all guard forbidding toolchain-version-conditioned test skips; keep pins fresh via Renovate automerge. Closes CAM-198 (container Node 18), CAM-192 (image staleness), CAM-180 (manual rebuild ceremony) as subsumed.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: setup-bun@v2 supports the bun-version-file input (reads .bun-version, .tool-versions, or package.json). Default cascade when unpinned is packageManager -> engines.bun -> latest, which is exactly why the current unpinned CI floats to 1.3.x.

Renovate ships a dedicated bun-version manager matching /(^|/)\.bun-version$/ by default with npm versioning (npm datasource); it is separate from the bun manager (bun.lock/package.json). .tool-versions is handled by the asdf manager; Docker FROM tags by the dockerfile manager; workflow actions by the github-actions manager. Direct page fetch failed once; content confirmed via search snapshot of the same URL.

userStories.title: Pin bun and Node versions with a shared toolchain reader
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need one repo-root source of truth for the bun and Node versions so that CI, the worker image, and the container preflight all read the same pins and can never silently diverge.
acceptanceCriteria: A .bun-version file at repo root contains exactly 1.3.13 (single line, exact semver, no prefix). [oracle: file-assert grep -Eq '^1\.3\.13$' .bun-version]
A .tool-versions file at repo root pins an exact Node 22.x version in asdf format. [oracle: file-assert grep -Eq '^nodejs 22\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' .tool-versions]

A new pure module src/config/toolchain.ts exports readPinnedBunVersion and readPinnedNodeVersion that read those files (injectable read seam, trims whitespace, returns null on missing/malformed content, never throws). [oracle: bun test test/config/toolchain.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: .bun-version, .tool-versions, src/config/toolchain.ts, test/config/toolchain.test.ts. Pick the current Node 22 LTS patch release for .tool-versions (issue requires >= 22 for knip's node:util styleText, see CAM-198). Gotcha (spec): setup-bun@v2 already reads package.json packageManager/engines.bun by default; .bun-version is the explicit, Renovate-manageable single source, so do NOT add engines.bun/packageManager to package.json. Follow patterns.md: injectable reader seam, null-on-error, no fs at import time. Downstream consumers: check-ci-parity (US-002), buildDockerBuildArgv (US-003), toolchain assert (US-006/007).

userStories.title: Pin CI bun via bun-version-file and enforce it in ci-parity
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need CI to resolve bun from .bun-version instead of floating to latest, with the ci-parity gate enforcing the pin, so that the CI toolchain is locked to the same version the container and host use.
acceptanceCriteria: .github/workflows/ci.yml passes bun-version-file: .bun-version to oven-sh/setup-bun@v2 and contains no floating bun-version: latest. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'bun-version-file: .bun-version' .github/workflows/ci.yml]

scripts/check-ci-parity.ts gains a ci-parity assertion that FAILS when the setup-bun step lacks bun-version-file: .bun-version or when .bun-version is absent/malformed, proven by unit tests for both the passing and failing workflow YAML shapes. [oracle: bun test test/check-ci-parity.test.ts]
The full spine passes with the new assertion active. [oracle: bun run check:all]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: .github/workflows/ci.yml, scripts/check-ci-parity.ts, test/check-ci-parity.test.ts, test/ci-workflow.test.ts (may assert workflow shape; update if stale). Gate-spine convention (patterns.md, CAM-59): CI calls only bun run check:all; ci-parity is the sync-enforcer, so extend checkParity/checkParityFromFile rather than adding a new ci.yml step. Reuse readPinnedBunVersion from US-001 (or the injectable-read pattern) so the assertion compares against the actual pin file, satisfying the spec AC that the CI-resolved bun equals .bun-version.

userStories.title: Feed the worker Dockerfile toolchain from the pins
userStories.description: As a loop operator, I need the worker image's bun and Node versions to be derived from .bun-version and .tool-versions at build time so that the container gates run the exact same toolchain as the host and CI (closing the bun 1.2.23 and Debian Node 18 gaps).
acceptanceCriteria: .devcontainer/Dockerfile declares ARG BUN_VERSION before FROM and uses FROM oven/bun:${BUN_VERSION}-slim (no hardcoded 1.2 tag remains). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'FROM oven/bun:${BUN_VERSION}-slim' .devcontainer/Dockerfile]

The Dockerfile installs Node pinned to the .tool-versions target (>= 22, via ARG NODE_VERSION fed NodeSource setup or a pinned upstream binary), and the Debian apt 'nodejs npm' install form is gone. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -Eq 'apt-get install.*nodejs npm|nodejs npm \\' .devcontainer/Dockerfile]

buildDockerBuildArgv (src/supervisor/worker-container.ts) emits --build-arg BUN_VERSION=<pinned> (and the Node pin arg) sourced from the US-001 toolchain reader by default, with explicit overrides still injectable for tests. [oracle: bun test test/worker-container.test.ts]
The pinned Claude Code CLI install and DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 are preserved unchanged. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1' .devcontainer/Dockerfile]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: .devcontainer/Dockerfile, src/supervisor/worker-container.ts, test for worker-container argv. Gotcha (spec): an ARG declared before FROM is only usable in the FROM line; re-declare any ARG needed after FROM. The ONLY docker build call site is runWorkerContainer via buildDockerBuildArgv (ensure-container.ts reuses it), so wiring the default there covers both the sidecar auto-rebuild path and initial creation; there is no separate release-build docker path (build-release.sh does not docker build). Keep the HOST_UID/HOST_GID build-arg pairing logic intact. Preserve the git-credential helper, firewall sudoers, and claude-config COPY blocks (CAM-150/179 history in Dockerfile comments).

userStories.title: Drop bun-version-conditioned skips; make Ink stdin tests version-agnostic
userStories.description: As a loop operator, I need the previously version-skipped Ink keypress tests to run unconditionally on every toolchain so that no in-container gate can be blind to a test that the host and CI execute.
acceptanceCriteria: No test file conditions a skip on Bun.version/process.version: the bunVersionOk probes and their skipIf usages in test/dashboard.test.ts and test/ui/init-setup-screen-keys.test.ts are removed and those tests run unconditionally. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -rq 'bunVersionOk' test/]

The un-skipped tests pass on both bun 1.2.x and 1.3.x by flushing enough macrotask ticks (two) after stdin-driven state updates, via a shared flush helper. [oracle: bun test test/dashboard.test.ts test/ui/init-setup-screen-keys.test.ts]

scripts/cam/patterns.md gains an appended bullet marking the CAM-186 version-skip pattern as retired by CAM-201 (old bullet preserved, file never truncated). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'CAM-201' scripts/cam/patterns.md]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: test/dashboard.test.ts, test/ui/init-setup-screen-keys.test.ts, scripts/cam/patterns.md. Root cause (patterns.md CAM-186 bullet, line ~308): bun 1.2.x needs TWO macrotask ticks to flush ink-testing-library stdin-driven state into lastFrame(); bun >= 1.3 needs one. An extra tick is harmless on 1.3, so awaiting two ticks unconditionally is version-agnostic. IMPORTANT ordering: this story MUST land before the guard gate (US-005) or check:all goes red at the story boundary. The container running this cycle may still be bun 1.2.23 (rebuild lands in US-007), which is exactly why the double-tick fix, not a bare skip-removal, is required for in-container bun test to stay green. Do not change divider-color/glyph conventions; only timing.

userStories.title: Add check:all guard gate forbidding toolchain-version-conditioned skips
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need a quality gate that fails when any test skip is conditioned on the runtime toolchain version so that a worker can never again mask a failing test from the in-container gates while the host and CI run it (the cam/pr-66 green-in-container/red-in-CI class).
acceptanceCriteria: A new gate script (scripts/check-version-skips.ts) scans test files and FAILS when a skip form (skipIf / .skip / skipUnless / todoIf) is conditioned, directly or via a same-file variable derived from them, on Bun.version, process.version, or process.versions. [oracle: bun test test/check-version-skips.test.ts]

The gate does NOT flag skips conditioned on process.platform, process.env, or capability probes (e.g. the CAM-59 real-tmux/git availability skips in test/integration/ stay legal); fixtures under test/fixtures/ prove both the positive (version-skip fails) and negative (platform/capability-skip passes) cases. [oracle: bun test test/check-version-skips.test.ts]

The gate is registered in the GATES manifest in scripts/check-all.ts (spine coverage only; no new ci.yml step) and ci-parity stays green. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'check-version-skips' scripts/check-all.ts]
The full spine passes with the guard active. [oracle: bun run check:all]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: scripts/check-version-skips.ts, scripts/check-all.ts (GATES entry), test/check-version-skips.test.ts, test/fixtures/version-skip-guard/*. Follow the gate-spine convention (patterns.md CAM-59): add to GATES only, verify with bun run check:ci-parity. Two-pass detection handles the real incident shape: a module-level const derived from Bun.version (bunVersionOk) later used in skipIf. Exclude test/fixtures/ from the real scan so the guard's own fixtures do not trip it; scan only test/ (not scripts/) to avoid the debt-marker self-reference gotcha (patterns.md CAM-60). Mirror check-debt-markers.ts structure (exported pure checker + CLI entrypoint + injectable file-list seam). Follow the oracle-friendly manifest design bullet when adding the GATES entry.

userStories.title: Add fail-closed container toolchain assert to the preflight layer
userStories.description: As a loop operator, I need the preflight to assert that the running cam-worker image's bun and Node equal the repo pins so that a stale-toolchain container is detected as a first-class, machine-readable condition instead of silently running divergent gates.
acceptanceCriteria: A toolchain assert helper (in src/supervisor/preflight-container.ts or a sibling module) probes bun --version and node --version inside the container via an injectable exec seam and compares them to readPinnedBunVersion/readPinnedNodeVersion (bun exact match; node compared with the leading 'v' stripped), returning a discriminated result { ok: true } | { ok: false; mismatches: [...] } and never throwing. [oracle: bun test test/toolchain-assert.test.ts]

The preflight surface exposes a distinct 'toolchain-mismatch' reason (alongside daemon-unreachable/image-missing/image-stale) so callers can branch on it. [oracle: file-assert grep -rq 'toolchain-mismatch' src/supervisor/]
A missing or malformed pin file fails closed (mismatch, not silent pass), proven by a unit test. [oracle: bun test test/toolchain-assert.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/preflight-container.ts (or new src/supervisor/toolchain-assert.ts), test mirror. Reuse the DockerProbe/ConfigSpawnFn seam shapes (no real docker in CI, macos-latest has no daemon). Probe argv shape: docker exec <containerName> bun --version and docker exec <containerName> node --version. Apply the JSON-reader shape-guard discipline from patterns.md (validate discriminator fields). Keep the helper pure/injectable; the wiring into ensure/dispatch is US-007, mirroring how preflight-container.ts landed tested-but-inert before CAM-150 wiring.

userStories.title: Auto-rebuild worker image on toolchain mismatch; escalate on rebuild failure
userStories.description: As a loop operator, I need the sidecar to auto-rebuild the worker image when the running container's toolchain diverges from the pins, re-assert, and only then dispatch, failing closed with an escalation when the rebuild cannot converge, so that a pin bump merged to main propagates to the running loop with zero operator action.
acceptanceCriteria: ensureWorkerContainer runs the US-006 toolchain assert after its reconcile branches; on mismatch it tears down (docker rm -f), rebuilds via runWorkerContainer with --build-arg BUN_VERSION from .bun-version plus HOST_UID/HOST_GID, restarts the container, and re-asserts; dispatch is allowed only after a passing re-assert. [oracle: bun test test/ensure-container.test.ts]

A rebuild failure or a still-mismatching re-assert throws a typed ToolchainMismatchError; runSidecar catches it (instanceof, mirroring FirewallError/ContainerConfigError), refuses dispatch, and escalates (stderr line + the sidecar escalation channel). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'ToolchainMismatchError' src/commands/sidecar.ts]

The toolchain assert (two cheap docker execs) runs on every container ensure invocation and the ensure path is exercised before dispatch cycles, so a running loop picks up a merged pin change (e.g. container bun 1.2.23 != .bun-version 1.3.13) and auto-rebuilds on the next cycle with zero operator action; the docker build is triggered ONLY on mismatch (or the existing stale/absent branches), never unconditionally per dispatch, proven by a test asserting reused+matching produces zero build calls. [oracle: bun test test/ensure-container.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/ensure-container.ts, src/commands/sidecar.ts, tests (ensure-container + sidecar fail-closed spy test: when ensureContainerFn throws ToolchainMismatchError the loop deps are never built). Follow the applyFirewallIfPresent/applyConfigIfPresent extraction style to stay under biome complexity 15. After a rebuild the firewall + config repair must still run (they are unconditional post-reconcile steps). Gotchas (spec): docker build takes minutes but Docker layer cache reduces cost; rebuild only on mismatch. If ensureContainerFn is currently invoked once per sidecar boot, move/also invoke the ensure (or at minimum the assert-and-rebuild path) into the per-cycle path the sidecar loop runs before dispatch, so a merge picked up by the running loop triggers the rebuild without a sidecar restart; keep host-mode (isolation != container) a complete no-op. This story delivers the CAM-192 (image staleness) and CAM-180 (manual rebuild ceremony) closures; US-003 delivers CAM-198 (Node 18). Reference all three as subsumed/closed in the PR body at ship time.

userStories.title: Add Renovate config auto-updating the toolchain pins
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need Renovate to keep .bun-version, .tool-versions, the Docker base image, and GitHub Actions current with automerge gated on green CI so that the pins stay fresh with zero hand-editing and every bump is validated by the full check:all spine before landing.
acceptanceCriteria: A renovate.json at repo root enables coverage for the bun-version manager (.bun-version), the asdf manager (.tool-versions), the dockerfile manager (Docker base image), and the github-actions manager (none of them disabled). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'bun-version' renovate.json]

Automerge is enabled for patch, minor, AND major updates on those managers, and the config does not set ignoreTests, so automerge remains gated on the required CI status check. [oracle: file-assert grep -q '"automerge": true' renovate.json && ! grep -q 'ignoreTests' renovate.json]

A test validates that renovate.json parses as JSON and asserts the manager/automerge shape (schema field present, no floating-disable of the four managers). [oracle: bun test test/renovate-config.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Files: renovate.json, test/renovate-config.test.ts. Official docs consulted: the bun-version manager matches /(^|/)\.bun-version$/ by default with npm versioning (https://docs.renovatebot.com/modules/manager/bun-version/); .tool-versions is the asdf manager; both are enabled by default under config:recommended, so the config mainly adds packageRules with automerge + matchUpdateTypes [patch, minor, major]. Renovate automerge waits for required branch status checks by default; the CI workflow must be a required check on main (repo-settings side, verify at ship). One-time out-of-band operator action (spec gotcha, NOT a story): install the Renovate GitHub App on the repo (public repo, free). Keep the config lint-clean JSON (biome does not lint .json by default, but keep 2-space style consistent).
